reason: The core arithmetic is overstated. v3 (CONTEXT 21:05Z (1)) codes the SEC file against ITS OWN base display, not against our LB row. So exp81 (exp70g ~0.95634) reads '+' as soon as it DISPLAYS 0.957, i.e. at a gain of about +1.6e-4, even if exp78b holds the row. The finding's +6.6e-4 is the gain needed to overtake exp78b on the row, which v3 never requires. Under the finding's own prior SEC ~N(0, 8e-4), P(detect) is 0.42 on the non-holder vs about 0.49 on the holder (the 0.957 block has 38 teams, so the gap is about 2.6e-5). That is about +0.07, not 0.20 -> 0.45. The only real gain is closing the lever: on a non-holder, a 0.956 exp81 codes '?' and cannot close SEC. That is diagnostic value about the public embryo only. The extra sensitivity sits in the 2e-5..1.6e-4 band on ONE embryo (~29% of the test). Our record says deltas that small carry no private sign: weight swaps were 0/5 on the LB, forkmid was +5-9e-5 public with the private sign unknown, and v3 itself puts only ~1-3% of SEC/CI mass in the U window. So private value is about 0. Feasibility is also worse than stated. exp82a/exp82b exist only as scratch builds (round21 scan notes, ffc00631/7cd1e3ed): no repo build, no dummy, no CONTEXT gate. The holder is unknown until ~07:30Z (exp78b) and ~08:35-09:15Z (exp78a), so both dummies (~0.8 GPU-h) would have to run on speculation. In the main scenario where exp78b is the holder, v3 W2a already goes to exp80a. SEC then drops to W2b behind E10 and a CI '+' stack, so it may not be submitted on 28 Sep at all. If exp80a later takes the row, exp82b becomes a non-holder again. v3 has no code table for a file on a 0.957 base, so the amendment needs new rule text written under time pressure in the autonomous night. It is not post-hoc if logged before 07:30Z, and it is not a new mechanism (a stack of scored levers), so it does not break R8. But it adds branching for about 0 private gain.
fix: Keep v3/N2 as pre-registered: SEC file = exp81 on exp70g. At most, log one CONTEXT clause before exp78b's terminal header (~07:30Z) that fixes the reading instead of the file. If at the exp81 read the holder is not exp70g, exp81 still codes '+' at a display >= 0.957 (as v3 already says) and '?' at 0.956. That '?' lets W4's full stack on the best base (already allowed by v3 (8)) include n2a only if exp81 read '+'. Do not build or dummy exp82a/exp82b unless a W4 full stack actually needs them.
realistic_gain: Private: ~0 (the public-only detection threshold drops from ~1.6e-4 to ~2.6e-5; P(detect) goes 0.42 -> 0.49 under N(0,8e-4), all on one embryo). Maybe one W4 slot saved, if SEC reads '+' on the holder. Cost: 2 speculative dummies (~0.8 GPU-h), new code rules for a 0.957 base, and a risk that SEC gets no 28 Sep slot at all when exp78b is the holder (W2a = exp80a).
